name: claude-code-mods
description: Small Claude Code mods: a last-turn summary band, a cross-project notes pane, and a running-sessions pane.

plugins.name: turn-pulse
plugins.description: A band above the prompt summarizing the last turn: duration, files edited, tool results, usage-limit cost.

plugins.name: notes
plugins.description: Save chat text with /note and review it in a side pane with done checkboxes.

plugins.name: sessions
plugins.description: A side pane listing the sessions running on this machine and their status.
